name.sr: Lažni posao od kuće: lajkujte proizvode na Telegramu, pa uplatite za „zadatke”
name.en: Fake work-from-home job: like products on Telegram, then pay for “tasks”

how.sr: Oglas, ponekad u ime poznate firme, nudi brzu i laku zaradu od kuće. Posle prijave vas dodaju u Telegram grupu gde dobijate zadatke: lajkovanje proizvoda ili videa, „klikovi” za treniranje veštačke inteligencije. Prve male isplate stignu, a onda morate da „kupite” proizvod ili uplatite depozit preko lažnog sajta da biste dobili proviziju, svaki put sve više. Posle nekoliko uplata nestaju.
how.en: An ad, sometimes in a well-known company’s name, offers quick, easy money from home. After you sign up you’re added to a Telegram group and given tasks: liking products or videos, “clicks” to train AI. The first small payouts arrive, then you must “buy” a product or pay a deposit through a fake site to earn your commission, more each time. After a few payments they vanish.

text.sr: Prelazak u Telegram grupu i zadaci.
text.en: A move to a Telegram group and tasks.
A payment to unlock your commission.

text.sr: Zdravo! Tražimo saradnike za rad od kuće, 1–2 sata dnevno. Posao je jednostavan: ocenjujete proizvode u onlajn prodavnici i za svaki zadatak dobijate proviziju, isplata istog dana. Ako vas zanima, javite se našoj koordinatorki na Telegramu: [link]
text.en: Hi! We’re looking for people to work from home, 1–2 hours a day. The work is simple: you rate products in an online shop and earn a commission per task, paid the same day. If you’re interested, contact our coordinator on Telegram: [link]

en: A real employer never asks you to pay to work.
Pay out of proportion to the effort.
Contact only via Telegram or WhatsApp.
A copy of a known company’s site for “purchases”.

sr: Ne uplaćujte ništa i ne šaljite dokumente.
Proverite oglas na zvaničnom sajtu firme.
Ako ste uplatili, javite banci i prijavite na Sajber straži.
en: Don’t pay anything and don’t send documents.
Check the job ad on the company’s official website.
If you paid, tell your bank and report it on Sajber straža.
